content:
XChat，the standalone messaging app under X for iPhone and iPad, is currently not available on the App Store.

The reason for the app's removal remains unclear, and the Android version appears to still be downloadable from the Google Play Store as normal.

XChat was launched earlier this year as a standalone version of the direct messaging feature between X users.

Update: Although the reason XChat was removed from the App Store is still unclear, it can be confirmed that this was not an app removal by Apple. According to sources familiar with the matter, it was the developer that voluntarily removed the app. XChat has also disappeared from the Google Play Store. It appears that X has decided to discontinue the app after just a few months.
